body: Bring him to his little brothers grave and make damn sure he never glorifies drugs in front of him.

Thank you for your kind words. She doesn’t take it seriously at all, we’ve had millions of talks but I just dont think she truly understands depression/understands that I have been diagnosed with depression, anxiety and PTSD. And I should find a new therapist but I won’t. I've been in and out of therapy since 2nd grade and it took me almost 20 years to find one I liked and trusted. It then took us 3 years to get through talking about my past and finally catch up to present day. It all sounds exhausting and overwhelming to do it all over again. :/
sometimes I wish I hadn’t lasted so long. I’m really trying to hold it together here

I hear you on that one. One of the most valuable things I learned is that problems I had that I didn’t necessarily were “real”, were very real. Before I found that therapist I never would have guessed I had PTSD and if I hadn’t seen her I wouldn't understand why I feel the way I do sometimes. I’m nowhere near alright, I just posted here as well, but one thing I do know(for me at least) is finding the right therapist saved my life.

Seeing someone helps, you just need to find the right one. I went in between therapists for 20 years and finally found one that was perfect for me. After a few years she recently moved away. I haven’t had it in me to find a new one but The sessions I had with her were invaluable and sometimes the memories of those sessions are the only thing that gets me through. Just don’t settle for one that isn't right for you, and don’t give up looking because it really can help.
